scripts.text: You are carrying too many items. Come back after taking off some of them.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品太多了。请卸下一些物品后再来。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight. Come back after reducing the weight.
scripts.translation: 你携带的重量太重了。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Hey. This is too dangerous a place for you. You cannot keep yourself safe. Get out of here and go to the village right now!
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
嘿。这里对你来说太危险了。你无法保证自己的安全。快离开这里，现在就去村庄！

scripts.text:
[Taho]
We are gonna be killed all by that Bakonawa. Ah, we must slay him but unfortunately we are not prepared.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
我们要被那只巴库暴龙全杀光了。啊，我们必须消灭它，但不幸的是我们还没有做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Isn't there any company who can go with you? Or even if you wanna go alone, come after organizing a party.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
难道没有同伴可以和你一起去吗？或者即使你想独自前往，也请在组好队伍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Are you the leader of the Bakonawa slayers? The road is not well so we have to go down the cliff with a rope, is that OK?
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
你是巴库暴龙讨伐队的队长吗？路况不好，我们必须用绳子下到悬崖下面，这样可以吗？

scripts.text: Please weave a rope.
scripts.translation: 请编织一根绳子。

scripts.text: Now I will go down.
scripts.translation: 现在我要下去了。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Taho]
You came for slaying Bakonawa. The leader of your party has to help me weaving the rope for going down.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
你是来讨伐巴库暴龙的。你的队伍队长必须帮我编织用于下行的绳子。

scripts.text: Now I will go down.
scripts.translation: 现在我要下去了。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Oh, the rope got dropped. I have to make a new one.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
哦，绳子掉下去了。我得重新做一根。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Now I'm weaving, so you can go down when I'm done.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
我现在正在编织，等我完成后你就可以下去了。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
An unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
发生了一个未知的错误。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
The rope hasn't been weaved yet. Wait a little.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
绳子还没有编织好。请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Civilians cannot enter.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
平民禁止入内。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
The rope used for getting to the Lake is already broken. We are now cleaning up the surroundings so come back after some time.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
通往湖泊的绳子已经断了。我们正在清理周围的环境，请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
It's all cleaned up around here. Now you can go down again after getting a rope.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
这里已经清理干净了。现在你可以拿到绳子后再下去了。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
My name is Minky.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
我的名字是敏基。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Heehee, I could join the Bakonawa hunt, but I'd rather hide behind that rock and cheer you guys on.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
嘿嘿，我本可以参加巴库暴龙的讨伐，但我更想躲在那块岩石后面为你们加油。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Bakonawa becomes invincible at some point. When that time comes, listen to my guides carefully. Just trust me and all will be good.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
巴库暴龙在某个时间点会变得无敌。当那个时刻来临时，请仔细听从我的指导。只要相信我，一切都会好的。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Now I will make Bakonawa spring out from the lake.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
现在我要让巴库暴龙从湖里跳出来了。

scripts.text: Hold on! I'm not ready yet!
scripts.translation: 等一下！我还没准备好！

scripts.text: Let's do it!
scripts.translation: 开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Oh... alright... tell me when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
哦...好吧...等你准备好了告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Then I will drop a drop of Albopal to this lake.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
那么我要往湖里滴一点Albopal了。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Once Bakonawa tastes this, he will surface...
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
一旦巴库暴龙尝到这个味道，它就会浮出水面...

scripts.text:
[Taho]
I am dropping the Alpopal to make Bakonawa mad. Bakonawa can be a good source of protein once we get him.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
我要滴入Albopal让巴库暴龙发狂。等我们抓到它，它可是很好的蛋白质来源。

scripts.text: It seems you are carrying too many different kinds of items. Please try again after reducing it.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品种类太多了。请减少物品种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems you are already carrying items of too much weight. Please try again after reducing the weight.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品总重量太重了。请减轻重量后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
This was found from Bakonawa's corpse. It would be better if you take this.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
这是从巴库暴龙的尸体上发现的。最好是你收下这个。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
We better hurry and get out of this place. This place is still dangerous even without Bakonawa...
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
我们得赶紧离开这里。即使没有巴库暴龙，这里依然很危险...

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Then let's use to the rope to go up!
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
那么我们用绳子爬上去吧！

scripts.text:
[Taho]
HMM. We almost got him but he is one fast creature...
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
嗯。我们差点就抓到它了，但它动作真快...

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Are we going to try again?
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
我们要再试一次吗？

scripts.text: Hold on a sec!
scripts.translation: 稍等一下！

scripts.text: Of course! We cannot stand back now!
scripts.translation: 当然！现在我们不能退缩！

scripts.text:
[Taho]
AWW... I almost brought him out.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
哎呀...我差点就把它引出来了。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
Then I will use Albopal once again to the lake.
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
那么我再往湖里滴一次Albopal。

scripts.text:
[Taho]
We are about to see Bakonawa with intenser anger...
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
我们要看到巴库暴龙更加愤怒的样子了...

scripts.text:
[Taho]
I am dropping Albopal like I did a while ago. I hope it pisses him off...
scripts.translation:
[塔霍]
我要像刚才那样滴入Albopal。希望能激怒它...
